v1: Ek sau atthaais GB ki khaali pendrive... ab isme movies bhar do, itni ki sirf zero point one GB bache! Sawaal ye hai: kya pendrive ka WEIGHT badhega?
v2: Aapko kya lagta hai? Badhega... same rahega... ya ghatega? Do second ruko, socho... aur comment karo!
v3: Nahi pata? Koi baat nahi, main batata hoon! Answer hai: haan, weight badhta hai! Par itna kam... ki duniya ki koi bhi machine naap nahi sakti!
v4: Pendrive ke andar arabon chhote memory cells hain. Har cell ek chhota sa dabba hai, jismein electrons trap kiye jaate hain. Electrons trapped matlab zero... khaali matlab one.
v5: Par dhyan do! Electrons bahar se nahi aate. Woh chip ke andar hi, ek jagah se doosri jagah shift hote hain. Toh electrons ki ginti... same rehti hai!
v6: Toh phir weight kyun badha? Kyunki trapped electrons mein extra energy hoti hai. Aur Einstein ka formula yaad hai? E equals m c square! Energy badhi... toh mass bhi badha!
v7: Kitna? Point ke baad solah zero... phir teen gram! Yaani ek bacteria se bhi tees hazaar guna halka!
v8: Ek line mein yaad rakho: data ka weight nahi hota, par uski energy ka hota hai! Comment mein batao, aapka guess sahi tha? Aur share karo us dost ko, jo kehta hai pendrive bhaari ho gayi!
